entries.4ebc30f07d2c4600: The 8th Medium-Term Management Plan (October 2022 to September 2027) sets “creation of growth businesses” as its basic policy and states that it will work on expanding overseas markets, expanding new markets and the industrial machinery market, and improving quality and development systems, among other initiatives. As its basic management policy, it states that it will provide products and services aimed at improving productivity, safety and comfort in agricultural and forestry machinery and green space management equipment, industrial machinery and environmental hygiene equipment, and disaster prevention-related fields, centered on high-pressure pump technology and two-stroke gasoline engine technology, in addition to fire extinguishers. It states that from October 2025 it established a Technology Headquarters to oversee product development in Japan and overseas.
